title: Dataset A Part 2 — All Models Summary

split.excluded_reason: Partial reporting years — MONTHS avg < 12 and/or material decline in row count and agency coverage

standard_population.rows_dropped_note: 546 train / 163 test rows excluded due to NA in log_prev_wp or log_prev_poly (rare negative PREV_ values from accounting adjustments)

models.description: Baseline: prior-year written premium only
models.notes: Univariate AR(1)-style baseline. Explains ~60% of test variance on log scale.

models.description: OLS_0 + prior-year policy count
models.notes: Adding log_prev_poly yields +0.094 test R² — largest single-predictor gain in the OLS progression.

models.description: OLS_1 + agency numerics (ACTIVE_PRODUCERS, AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR, MAX_AGE, MIN_AGE)
models.notes: Agency numeric features add modest gain (+0.003 test R²) on top of the lag variables.

models.description: OLS_2 + categorical factors (STATE_ABBR, PROD_LINE, PROD_ABBR, VENDOR, STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR)
models.notes: PROD_LINE is structurally nested in PROD_ABBR; R silently drops it. OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL removes it explicitly for a cleaner specification at identical performance.

models.description: Clean additive baseline: OLS_3 with PROD_LINE removed explicitly
models.notes: 48 full-rank coefficients, 43 significant at p<0.05. Performance identical to OLS_3 (delta=0.0000 on both splits). Serves as OLS benchmark and baseline for all subsequent tests (interactions, RF, LMM comparisons). PROD_LINE removed because its coefficient flipped sign across populations, revealing near-collinearity with PROD_ABBR.

models.description: OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL formula fit on PREV_LOSS_RATIO complete-case population (LR not null/sentinel)
models.population_note: Rows where PREV_LOSS_RATIO is non-null and non-sentinel — 90.8% train coverage, 84.7% test coverage
models.notes: Comparison baseline for OLS_4CC. The apparent performance jump vs OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL (0.7552 → 0.9208) is entirely population selection — the LR CC population excludes structurally lower-performing rows, not predictor contribution.

models.description: OLS_3CC + PREV_LOSS_RATIO
models.exclusion_reason: PREV_LOSS_RATIO contributes delta_test_R² = 0.0000 on the population-controlled comparison. The OLS_3→OLS_4CC jump (+0.1656) was entirely population selection. Coefficient is not material.

models.description: OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL formula fit on PREV_RETENTION_RATIO complete-case population
models.population_note: Rows where PREV_RETENTION_RATIO is non-null and non-sentinel — 37.75% train coverage, PL product line only (CL agencies do not report RETENTION_RATIO)
models.notes: Comparison baseline for OLS_5. High test R² is population selection — only 37.75% coverage, restricted to PL product line.

models.description: OLS_3_RET_CC + PREV_RETENTION_RATIO
models.exclusion_reason: delta_test_R² = +0.0009 on population-controlled comparison — negligible. Coverage is only 37.75% (PL only). Coefficient is negative (-0.34, t=-18.3) and likely reflects product-mix confound within PL, not retention signal.

models.description: All pairwise interactions from OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL: (additive terms)^2
models.exclusion_reason: 82 aliased (rank-deficient) terms from sparse categorical cells (PROD_ABBR × VENDOR, PROD_ABBR × STATE_ABBR). R's predict.lm() returned garbage predictions (not NA) for all test rows in near-singular subspaces. Catastrophic OOS collapse.

models.description: Numeric × numeric interactions only: all C(7,2)=21 pairs from OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL numeric predictors
models.exclusion_reason: Full-rank (0 aliased) but test R² = 0.7309 — worse than additive baseline (0.7552). 15/21 numeric interactions significant (train +0.0156) but they overfit. Key finding: log_prev_wp:log_prev_poly is strongest (est=0.037, |t|=42.6) — signal captured without the OOS cost by keeping terms additive.

models.description: Support-screened interactions: numeric×numeric + numeric×PROD_ABBR + numeric×STATE_ABBR + numeric×VENDOR. Cat×cat excluded.
models.predictors: main effects + numeric×numeric + numeric×PROD_ABBR + numeric×STATE_ABBR + numeric×VENDOR
models.exclusion_reason: 22 aliased terms from sparse individual PROD_ABBR levels (ANNIV12, CYCLES12, DTALK12, MOTORHOM12, SNOWMOBI12 + VENDORF). Near-singular subspaces cause garbage predictions on test. OOS collapse despite excluding cat×cat interactions.

models.description: Random forest with safe default hyperparameters (pre-tuning reference)
models.notes: Confirms RF materially outperforms OLS. Hyperparameter tuning yields marginal additional gain.

models.description: OOB-tuned random forest: best params from 48-model grid search
models.notes: Primary selected specification. Best out-of-sample performance across all models evaluated. Locked — no re-tuning.

models.description: RF_1_SAFE_TUNED + agency cluster membership feature (k=50, OOB-selected from k ∈ {5,10,20,30,50})

clustering.features: 15 z-scored agency-level features from 2006-2012 training profiles

models.exclusion_reason: delta seen-agency test R² = -0.0016, below the 0.005 materiality threshold. Agency clustering does not improve out-of-sample performance. RF_1_SAFE_TUNED retained as locked specification.

models.description: Null LMM: intercept + random agency intercept only, no fixed effects. Full population.
models.notes: Intercept-only null model used to establish the unconditional agency ICC = 0.1146 — agencies account for 11.5% of total log_wp variance before any predictors are added. Provides the pre-fixed-effects baseline for variance decomposition. Motivates inclusion of the agency random intercept in AGENCY_LMM_FULL. No predictive metrics reported.

models.description: Linear mixed model with random agency intercept, full population
models.formula: log_wp ~ log_prev_wp + log_prev_poly + ACTIVE_PRODUCERS + AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR + MAX_AGE + MIN_AGE + STATE_ABBR + PROD_ABBR + VENDOR + STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR + (1 | AGENCY_ID)
models.notes: Residual agency ICC of 0.2422 confirms meaningful agency-level clustering in residuals. Conditional test R² (+0.0055 vs OLS) reflects EBLUP borrowing from training agencies — negligible predictive benefit. LMM retained for structural interpretation, not prediction.

models.description: Agency random intercept LMM, PAI=99999 sentinel excluded
models.population_note: Excludes PAI=99999 sentinel rows (16,172 rows / 12.04% of full dataset; 351 agencies / 26.31% are catch-all placeholder)
models.notes: Marginal improvement over AGENCY_LMM_FULL (+0.0048 conditional test R²) from removing the PAI=99999 catch-all. Not material enough to justify restricting the deployment population.

models.description: Nested LMM with agency and parent random intercepts, PAI=99999 excluded
models.variance_components_note: Null parent ICC = 0.0069 — minimal parent contribution
models.notes: Best conditional test R² among all LMM variants (0.7659). Parent random effect contributes negligible additional signal over agency intercept alone — null parent ICC = 0.0069.

models.description: Agency random intercept LMM, restricted to true hierarchical rows (PAI != 99999 AND PAI != AID)
models.population_note: 59.17% of full dataset rows are self-parenting (PAI==AID). TRUE_PARENT keeps only agencies with a distinct parent — 29,216 train / 9,473 test.
models.notes: Lower RMSE/MAE than full-population LMMs attributable to population characteristics. No material benefit over the full-population models for deployment.

models.description: Nested LMM with agency and parent random intercepts, true hierarchical rows only
models.notes: Nested structure provides no measurable benefit over single-level agency intercept on the true-parent population.

models.description: RF_1_SAFE_TUNED retrained on all eligible data (2006-2014). Primary deployment artifact.

oob_diagnostics.note: OOB from all-data refit — diagnostic only, not a holdout metric

predictions_2015.purpose: One-year-ahead artifacts using 2014 lag predictors and 2015 agency/product info. Not evaluation.

models.notes: No untouched holdout — all 2006-2014 data used for training. Official evaluation evidence comes from RF_1_SAFE_TUNED on 2013-2014 holdout.

models.description: OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL retrained on all eligible data (2006-2014). Reference/interpretability artifact.
models.notes: Supports coefficient interpretability and the live OLS prediction endpoint. Not the primary deployment model.

models.description: AGENCY_LMM_FULL retrained on all eligible data (2006-2014). Reference artifact.
models.notes: Agency ICC increases to 0.2632 with full 2006-2014 data (vs 0.2422 on 2006-2012 only). Structural diagnostic use only.

model_selection_outcome.lmm_role: STRUCTURAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — RF_1_SAFE_TUNED outperforms all LMM variants by +0.1232 test R²
model_selection_outcome.ols_interaction_branch: ALL_FAILED — additive OLS specification is locked
model_selection_outcome.rationale: RF_1_SAFE_TUNED achieves test R²=0.8839 vs OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL at 0.7552 (+0.1287). Agency clustering, lagged loss ratio, lagged retention ratio, and all OLS interaction variants were tested and rejected. OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL is retained as the interpretable benchmark and powers the live prediction endpoint.

ranked_full_population_comparison.note: Ranked by test R² on the standard full evaluation population (n=30,981 test rows, 2013-2014). CC-population models and LMM sub-population models excluded — evaluated on different row sets and not directly comparable.
